question.text: Fair-value valuation for PMS debt and money market holdings is required to be done via:

answer.text: APMI-empanelled valuation agencies, with ultimate responsibility remaining with the portfolio manager

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook requires portfolio managers to mandatorily use one or more APMI-empanelled valuation agencies for the valuation of debt and money market securities, while the ultimate responsibility for fair valuation continues to remain with the portfolio manager. The Trap: "Historical cost" and "book value only" ignore current market conditions, and "mark-to-market only" misses the requirement to use empanelled valuation agencies for the relevant security classes. Note: Even when valuations are sourced from an empanelled agency, the portfolio manager remains accountable for the fairness of the NAV reported to clients and should review and document the valuation process.
